description: Permanently delete one asset from the library this key reaches. Its spicy://a/<id> uri stops working in new requests at once and the stored file is removed; there is no undo. In a team library, developers can delete only what they saved. Deleting does not give back today's allowance of new assets. Only delete an asset the user named. Requires a user confirmation round.

assetId.description: The asset id (ast_…) or its spicy://a/<id> reference; both are accepted.

name: spicyapi_asset_delete
title: Delete a saved SpicyAPI asset
